title: Peak ground acceleration.
officialText: Peak ground acceleration shall be determined based on either (1) a site-specific study taking into account soil amplification effects as specified in Section 11.4.7 of ASCE 7-10 or (2) the Maximum Considered Geometric Mean peak ground acceleration adjusted for Site Class effects PGA as provided in Table 1813.2.1 without adjustment for M targeted risk.
